definitions.rod_open_free: free_name_search=yes AND access is open or disclaimer_click (reached with no login, CAPTCHA, fee or block)
definitions.rod_walled: rod.access is login, captcha, payment or blocked; 'blocked' includes a Cloudflare 'Just a moment' / bot challenge served to a plain browser-UA GET
definitions.images_free: yes = deed images viewable on screen at no charge, either seen on the portal or verified by the repo on the same vendor app; printing may still need a paid session
definitions.legal_description_in_index: yes = the ROD index exposes a property/legal description column or search field (usually brief: lot, subdivision, acreage, or a PD: book/page reference); the full metes-and-bounds legal is only on the deed image
definitions.legal_description_online: counties where at least one free online route shows some legal description: free ROD images, a description column in the ROD index, or a legal-description field in a public GIS parcel layer (county layer or statewide NC OneMap legdecfull, which is the assessor's short legal)
definitions.index_back_to_before_1980: ROD online index start year stated on the portal is before 1980 (null years are not counted)
